component.name: ComposeDeck
component.summary: Manage Docker Compose projects with Podman or Docker

description.p: ComposeDeck is a desktop app for managing Docker Compose projects running on Podman or Docker.
It scans a folder for compose projects, shows which services are running, and lets you start, stop, and restart individual apps or all of them at once.

ul.li: Overview of all compose projects with running, stopped, and partial states
Per-project service list with health, ports, and logs
Start, stop, and restart controls for single services or whole projects

description.p: ComposeDeck talks directly to the Podman or Docker API socket and does not require a separate Compose binary.
Overview dashboard, settings, shortcuts, and richer service details.

ul.li: Overview dashboard with status filters, pinned apps, and bulk start/stop/restart.
Settings for the apps directory, refresh interval, and pinned-app ordering.
Ports table with host, container, and protocol columns plus application shortcuts.
Logs viewer with tail size, copy, save, and refresh.
Compose project names, compose-file service ordering, and creation of missing services.
Window size is remembered between launches.
